title: Pickup marker appears offset from actual GPS location
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in RideMap, the user encountered: Pickup marker appears offset from actual GPS location.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Set pickup
2. Observe UI state: 123 Main St
3. Observe UI state: You are here

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: You are here.

## Environment
- App: RideMap
- Platform: android
